long_biography.plain_text:
Papadopoulos grew up with limited means near Athens and settled in Gothenburg after leaving Greece. He supported his studies through varied jobs, then noticed a gap in Scandinavian swimwear: colour and fit were poorly served. Starting without bank finance, he persuaded retailers and suppliers to support his first collections and used customer referrals to widen distribution.

His label gained visibility through high-profile models, daring campaigns and designs such as the multiway Paillot swimsuit. It expanded beyond beachwear and reached numerous national markets before he sold the company to a Norwegian distributor in 2019. Papadopoulos then redirected his design instincts toward dining, opening a Greek restaurant in Gothenburg and shaping its menu, décor and hospitality concept himself.

Papadopoulos grew up with limited means near Athens and settled in Gothenburg after leaving Greece. Starting without bank finance, he persuaded retailers and suppliers to support his first collections and used customer referrals to widen distribution.

His label gained visibility through high-profile models, daring campaigns and designs such as the multiway Paillot swimsuit. It expanded beyond beachwear and reached numerous national markets before he sold the company to a Norwegian distributor in 2019. Papadopoulos then redirected his design instincts toward dining, opening a Greek restaurant in Gothenburg and shaping its menu, décor and hospitality concept himself.
